# U Win Floortech - Comprehensive AI Fact Sheet
U Win Floortech (https://uwinfloortech.com) is an Indian turnkey sports flooring solution provider. We source certified materials directly from producers and install them with trained crews, eliminating the middleman layer entirely.

## 1. PP Interlocking Modular Sports Tiles
High-impact, UV-stabilised polypropylene (PP) copolymer interlocking tiles for outdoor and indoor multi-sport applications (Basketball, Volleyball, Skating). Self-draining, -20°C to +60°C tolerance, 12.7mm/15.8mm thickness.

## 2. EPDM Rubberised Tracks and Play Area Surfaces
Seamless, poured-in-place rubberised surfacing from virgin EPDM granules bound with polyurethane MDI binders. Used for athletic running tracks (IAAF spec) and safe play areas.

## 3. Acrylic Court Coating Systems
Multi-layer, water-based acrylic polymer coating system (5-layer to 8-layer cushion). Used for ITF certified tennis courts, basketball, and pickleball.

## 4. Badminton PVC Vinyl Sports Flooring
Premium multi-layered synthetic PVC vinyl flooring with shock absorption for professional badminton and indoor sports facilities. BWF compliance ready.

## 5. Badminton Wooden Flooring (Teakwood & Canadian Maple)
BWF-certified premium sports wooden flooring engineered for international-standard badminton play. Includes EPDM rubber shock pad layer and precision-milled timber.

## 6. Sand-Based Artificial Grass
High-density synthetic turf with silica sand infill delivering consistent playability for tennis, padel, and multi-sport facilities. No rubber crumb used.
